top_signals.title: Traders Who Rushed to Bonds as Haven Get Rattled in Reversal
top_signals.summary: A recent influx of bullish positioning across the US bond market just got smacked, as comments from a pair of Federal Reserve officials and fresh evidence of sticky inflation increased the odds of interest-rate hikes, sending Treasuries into a tailspin.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Rise on AI Enthusiasm, Bonds Decline: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks climbed after better-than-expected earnings from CoreWeave Inc. revived interest in the artificial intelligence trade, helping offset a Wall Street selloff fueled by hotter-than-expected US inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
